title: ExplorerPagesScreen
responsibility: The Pages screen: lists the pages of the app as cards, each with its own screenshot at the shown revision.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.index
inputs.description: Prepared history index of the selected repository and its recorded revisions, which the console loads through the client's index request. This screen and its frame never read it.

revisions.subject: Show each page's screenshot at the shown revision
revisions.author: Maya Chen

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.head
inputs.description: The selected revision, read by the console for exactly the shown commit. ExplorerFrame reads its registry: when registry.available is false, the frame shows its registry gap in place of the page cards.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of the selected commit, which the console reads only when the scope is a named commit (mode commit) and the index holds that parent; otherwise it is null, including for a branch address (mode current), a first commit and a failed read. This screen and its frame never read it.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.scope
inputs.description: The explorer scope of the shown revision; this screen passes the route's branch and the scope's commit to the index as its scope key, and ExplorerFrame reads its commit and sets the content's data-mode attribute from its mode.

summary.subject: Show each page's screenshot at the shown revision
summary.author: Maya Chen

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.route
inputs.description: The explorer location shown, which is the scope's location: its branch, commit, category and any entity, helper, section or tab. This screen reads its branch for the index's scope key, and the card links keep the location's branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.entities
inputs.description: The units of the selected revision as the explorer lists them, including those the shown commit removed when its first parent is held. Each entity whose category is pages becomes one card.

verdict.label: Evidence missing
reasons: No verification record is attached to this commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.lens
inputs.description: The host's answers about entities: relations for each page entity (its users, where it has any, are shown beside its link), evidence for each card's screenshot, and href for the card links; the screen computes none of them.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision reader (revision(commit)) that the host passes for the commits a history lists. Nothing this screen renders calls it.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: Base URL for retained recorded evidence media: the console sets it to its base plus /media/, and each card's screenshot is this value followed by the capture's media file name.

inputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.onroute
inputs.description: Receives the destination of a card link that a plain click follows: ExplorerFrame passes it to the links as navigation, and the console navigates there. This screen never changes the address itself.

outputs.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.pageCards
outputs.description: Page cards for the page entities of the shown revision, filtered by the index search and sorted by name within their unit groups (Uncategorized last), each with its usable screenshot whose link title names the commit it was captured at or reused from, or with an explicit gap when none is shown. A search that matches no page shows 'No pages match this search.', a revision with no pages shows 'No pages are in the registry of this revision.', and a revision without a registry shows the frame's 'No registry at this revision' message with its registry gap in place of the cards.

errors.name: ExplorerPagesScreen.callerError
errors.description: This component throws and catches nothing of its own: an error thrown by a host lens reader while the screen renders (relations, evidence or href) propagates unchanged, and an error thrown by onroute comes from a card link's click handler, which this screen does not catch. It defines no error type of its own.
